留空时自动使用输入框中的默认值。: Leave blank to use the defaults shown in each field.
Agent 按工具名调用。须以小写字母开头，支持小写字母、数字、下划线和短横线，: Agents call this tool by name. Use 2–64 characters, starting with a lowercase letter; lowercase letters, numbers, underscores and hyphens are allowed.
这段描述用于告诉 Agent 什么时候调用该能力。: Tell the agent when to use this capability.
调用参数由能力固定提供。: This capability has a fixed set of input parameters.
该能力暂无参数说明。: No parameter documentation is available for this capability.
此能力使用 Ollama。选择端点与模型，多条路由按优先级从小到大依次尝试。: This capability uses Ollama. Select an endpoint and model; routes are tried in ascending priority order.
请先在「外部能力」添加 Ollama 端点。: Add an Ollama endpoint under External models first.
暂无路由。添加后选择模型即可使用外部能力。: No routes yet. Add a route and select a model to enable this capability.
路由已移除，保存配置后生效: Route removed; save the configuration to apply
该端点暂无可选模型，请刷新模型列表。: No models available at this endpoint. Refresh the model list.
已确认模型支持图片: Confirmed that this model supports images
用服务端准备好的样例参数真实调用一次: Run a real call with the built-in sample input
（未提供，用路由的默认提示词）: (Not provided; using the route default prompt)
没有任何路由被尝试：这个能力当前没有可用路由，或输入在进入上游之前就被拒绝了。: No routes were attempted: this capability has no available route, or the input was rejected before forwarding.
MCP 配置已复制，可直接粘贴到客户端配置文件中: MCP configuration copied. Paste it into your client configuration file.

把这份配置粘贴到支持 HTTP 传输的 MCP 客户端，例如 Claude Co: Paste this configuration into an MCP client with HTTP transport support, such as Claude Code’s
尚未读取到 MCP API Key，请在“设置”中查看访问凭据。: MCP API Key is not loaded yet. Check access credentials in Settings.
复制的内容包含完整密钥；粘贴到客户端后请按 MCP API Key 的保密要求管: The copied configuration includes the full key. Keep this file private after adding it to your client.
控制 MCP 端点的网络可达范围，以及图片大小与并发上限。: Control MCP network access, image size and concurrency limits.
允许网络访问 MCP 端点: Allow network access to the MCP endpoint
裸机部署想彻底只监听本机，请设置环境变量 HOST=127.0.0.1 后重启；: To listen only on localhost outside Docker, set HOST=127.0.0.1 and restart. In Docker this also disables access through mapped ports.
范围 0.01–50 MB，超过限制的请求会在转发前拒绝。: Range: 0.01–50 MB. Larger images are rejected before forwarding.
范围 1–32，超出的请求会等待已有任务完成。: Range: 1–32. Additional requests wait for an active request to finish.
确定删除这条配置？被其他配置引用时不会删除。: Delete this configuration? Referenced configurations cannot be deleted.
轮转后，旧的{0}会立即失效。确定继续？: The old {0} will stop working immediately. Rotate it now?
浏览器未允许复制，请显示后手动复制: Clipboard access denied. Show the key and copy it manually.

定义 Agent 可调用的能力标识，并决定每个能力最终由哪些模型提供。: Define the capabilities agents can call and the models that provide them.
服务端未注册可用的能力: No capabilities are registered on the server
请求从能力出发，沿路由进入指定的 Ollama 模型；优先级越小越先尝试。: Requests follow capability routes to an Ollama model. Lower priority values are tried first.
还没有可用的 Ollama 端点，先登记服务地址。: No Ollama endpoints yet. Add a service URL first.
目前支持 Ollama。登记服务地址后，在能力编辑中选择端点与模型。: Ollama is currently supported. Add a service URL, then select its endpoint and model in a capability.
先添加一个 Ollama 端点: Add an Ollama endpoint to get started

查看或轮转 Agent 使用的 MCP 调用密钥。: View or rotate the MCP API key used by agents.
用于登录控制台和管理 API: Used to sign in to the console and admin API
用于 Agent 连接 /mcp: Used by agents to connect to /mcp

配置 Agent 可调用的工具，以及使用的模型和回退路由。: Configure the tools your Agent can call, with model selection and fallback routes.
选择能力使用的 Ollama 端点与模型，即可开始调用。: Choose the Ollama endpoint and model for a capability to start making calls.
关闭后仅允许本机与服务器同网段访问；通过反向代理时按代理地址判断。: When disabled, only this host and its local subnets can connect. Behind a reverse proxy, the proxy address determines access.
JPEG、PNG 或 WebP 图片的 Base64 内容，可包含 data U: Base64-encoded JPEG, PNG or WebP image, optionally including a data URL prefix
